items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: He liked us. He gave all youngsters a break. Yeah, we got along all right.

ctx.x: And it got to be his place. So evidently they must have did business, Minton and Mexico.

Minton was a nice guy because he used to be in the union, you know, a big shot. And at that time you couldn't work on a regular job in New York for six months when you first joined the union. But Minton, he'd let you go. He'd say, "Go ahead, son, go and meet" -- just don't worry -- because he had that part of the city to cover, you know, for musicians. He liked us. He gave all youngsters a break. Yeah, we got along all right.
That's where Duke used to lose all his money, at Minton's.
